name: Nagit
source:
[i]"Want to treat me like a child? Before you know it, you will be all mine."[/i]
[i]The idol of his brothers. Always acting tough.[/i]

Master Nagit is the younger prince, and very much loved by his brothers. He is surrounded by adults, so he acts older than his age. Perhaps he's even more mature than several of his brothers.

He's serious and pure and thinks too much about things, but I'm sure you can make him relax a bit.

[From the game's [url=http://4.bp.blogspot.com/-zKFlY0WOCQg/U95NrJ5lNwI/AAAAAAAAR98/R-FFc7nhVvc/s280/tumblr_mb63voEnPV1rf043io3_1280.png]promotional image[/url]]
